articles.summary: How Cekura Bench differs from τ-bench: full audio calls, a rule-based caller, call-level scoring, and an independent grader.

articles.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe Is #1 Overall on Our Speech-to-Text Benchmark
